key_insight: Scalarization connects interval-valued optimization to scalar problems, enabling a proximal point algorithm with global convergence and convexity-dependent rates.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a mathematically grounded approach to interval-valued lasso regression for machine learning with uncertain data.
method: Scalarize an unconstrained interval-valued objective and relate scalar optima to LU-nondominated solutions.
Apply a proximal point algorithm to the scalarized problem.
Establish sublinear convergence for convex problems and linear convergence for strongly convex problems.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical experiments, comparison with an existing method, and an interval-valued lasso application, but provides no quantitative results.
watch_item: Practical performance depends on scalarization choices and proximal subproblem costs, which are not detailed in the abstract.
paper_title: Proximal point algorithm for interval valued optimization problems with application to lasso problem
